tools.name: transcript_window
tools.description: Returns the last N candidate and interviewer turns, with partial segments flagged.

tools.name: claim_store
tools.description: Returns resume claims with ids and their covered state.

tools.name: interview_state
tools.description: Returns level, asked_ids, covered_ids, last answer length and score, ack spacing, seconds remaining.

tools.name: turn_validator
tools.description: Validates a proposed turn against the JSON schema and the grounding rule; rejects unquotable turns.

tools.name: speak
tools.description: Streams the say field to Kokoro TTS and aborts playback on candidate speech.
